blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Directions for ages 12+ years: Take one capsule daily. Continued use is suggested.
When traveling, take one capsule daily before and during the trip.
During antibiotic use, take one capsule daily and continue for 10 days after completion of antibiotics.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, vegetable magnesium stearate, and colors (titanium dioxide, fd&c red #40, fd&c blue #1).
Allergy friendly free from milk, wheat, eggs, tree nuts & peanuts.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Storage Instructions: Store Culturelle® in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
Tamper Evident: Product is sealed within blisters. Do not use if any part of the blister is torn, open or damaged.
Keep out of reach of children. Inform a healthcare professional before starting any dietary supplement, particularly if there is a known immune-compromised condition.

When first taking a probiotic, your gut microbiome adjusts. You may experience minor bloating, gas or intestinal gurgling which should subside with continued use. Consult your healthcare professional if symptoms continue after two weeks.
